desc:
🥚Welcome to Jump and Break an Egg! 🥚

How to Play:

⛏️ Break eggs to hatch rare animals
🐾 Grab them and escape the guards
💰 Place animals in your plot to earn cash
💪 Train to increase your jump power and reach higher zones
⚡ Upgrade your pickaxe, barbell, trails and coils
🏆 Discover every animal and complete your Index!


❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
🎮 Playable on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet!
